description: Get analytics metrics for a connected social account. Empty/available=false is not an error (see reason: NOT_SUPPORTED for networks without analytics such as WordPress and LinkedIn; e.g. NOT_AVAILABLE or PROVIDER_ERROR when a YouTube channel has not granted the Analytics API or YouTube rejected the call); the window must end today (or yesterday), max 90 days, and is served as the trailing 7/30/90 days (the response `range` shows the window actually used); for a BLUESKY account the response carries `impressions` and `reach` as {available:false, reason: NOT_PROVIDED_BY_NETWORK} because Bluesky does not expose them (never treat that as zero or as an error); a GBP account is a location and its analytics are per location: a location the connection can no longer access returns available=false with a reason (NOT_AVAILABLE or PROVIDER_ERROR), never an error; requires scope ANALYTICS_READ (the key can only be created by the workspace owner).

channel.description: Channel of the account, e.g. INSTAGRAM (UPPERCASE canonical, lowercase accepted).

name: get_account_analytics
